vault_auth_credential_type.name: HashiCorp Vault Authentication
vault_auth_credential_type.description: Authentication credential for HashiCorp Vault connections

fields.label: Vault URL
fields.help_text: The URL to the HashiCorp Vault server (e.g., https://vault.example.com:8200)

fields.label: Verify SSL
fields.help_text: Verify SSL certificates when connecting to Vault

fields.label: CA Certificate
fields.help_text: CA certificate to verify the Vault server SSL certificate

fields.label: AppRole Auth Path
fields.help_text: Path where AppRole auth method is mounted (default: approle)

fields.label: JWT Auth Path
fields.help_text: Path where JWT auth method is mounted (default: jwt)

vault_aws_lookup_credential_type.name: HashiCorp Vault AWS Secrets Engine Lookup
vault_aws_lookup_credential_type.description: Lookup credential for retrieving dynamic AWS credentials from Vault

metadata.label: AWS Mount Path
metadata.help_text: Path where the AWS secrets engine is mounted in Vault

metadata.label: AWS Role Name
metadata.help_text: Name of the AWS role configured in Vault to generate credentials for

metadata.label: Credential Type
metadata.help_text: Type of AWS credentials to generate (creds=IAM user, sts=assume role)

metadata.label: TTL
metadata.help_text: Time-to-live for the generated credentials (e.g., "1h", "30m"). Optional.

metadata.label: Namespace Override
metadata.help_text: Override the namespace for this specific lookup (Vault Enterprise only)
